attacks.name: Hex Shot
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make 1 additional |*Hex Shot| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Dark Lightning
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

|!wild| |*Arc|: After this attack is resolved, choose a number of other enemy characters within |!range| 3 of the defender equal to or less than the number of |!wild| in the attack roll. The chosen characters suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Black Arts
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 3 of this character. The chosen character may remove up to 3 |!damage|. If it does, the chosen character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition. A character may be affected by this superpower only once per Round.

superPowers.name: Invisibility Cloak
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack or would make a dodge roll, you may use this superpower. This character uses its |!mystic| Defense to defend or dodge. During this defense or dodge roll, this character adds Blanks in its roll to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Possessed by Nisanti
superPowers.body: When this character suffers |!damage| from an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may transform into |*Hood (Possessed)|. If this character would be Dazed, before being Dazed, it transforms into |*Hood (Possessed)|, then it is Dazed.

steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.
After this attack is resolved, this character transforms into |*Hood (Normal)|.

|!wild| |*Empowered Arc|: After this attack is resolved, choose a number of other enemy characters within |!range| 3 of the defender equal to or less than the number of |!wild| in the attack roll. The chosen characters suffer 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Demonic Resilience
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 2, to a minimum of 1.

superPowers.name: Mystic Vulnerability
superPowers.body: While defending against a |!mystic| attack, this character does not add additional dice to its defense roll as a result of |!critical| results. If this character is damaged by a |!mystic| attack, after the attack is resolved it transforms into |*Hood (Normal)|.
